CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.document_actor(p_workspace uuid, p_manage boolean DEFAULT false)
AS $function$ BEGIN RETURN zoi.company_document_authority(p_workspace,CASE WHEN p_manage THEN 'document_manage' ELSE 'document_read' END,NULL,false);END $function$

authority_alignment.ops_role: Keep STABLE, no locks, existing ACL/signature. Project the exact canonical workspace/profile/member role decision: member role where known; owner fallback only when member absent and actual workspace owner; forged owner label becomes viewer; unknown/nonmember becomes null. No new global session predicate.
authority_alignment.company_document_authority: Preserve the p_lock=false nonlocking preliminary contract and existing current-session checks/expected actor. p_lock=true obtains canonical workspace_locked_role first, rechecks locked current profile mapping/expected actor and the unchanged permission-role matrix, then rechecks current session before return.
authority_alignment.reason: These seven mutators otherwise obtain advisory/profile/document/Operations row locks before their final authority call. Only changing the final helper would create row-to-workspace inversion against canonical workspace-first writers.
authority_alignment.read_context: All thirteen actual direct helper callers are VOLATILE. The five read RPCs perform ordinary SELECTs before the existing final locked authority check. Existing final p_lock=true already performs FOR SHARE and is not a read-only transaction contract; do not claim new GET support.
authority_alignment.additional_projection: public.documents_list twice selects workspace_members.role directly. Exact guarded replacement with ops_role is needed so owner-without-member receives owner in the real Documents UI, not merely RPC authorization success.
preserve: No existing writer signatures/nonce/CAS semantics changed
No Documents editor/viewer privacy policy broadened
No global session predicate added to ops_role
No call to volatile locking helper inside STABLE per-row RLS lookup

alignment_gates: Capture exact actual function bodies/owners/ACL/config AND table constraints/triggers/policies/index metadata before changing anything.
Role projection test for every one of37 direct callers and both Operations RLS policies; actual owner missing member, owner/admin/editor/viewer, forged owner, unknown role, other account/workspace.
Actual Company open/create/project/task/recovery receipt flow with owner missing membership, not only a helper test.
Actual Documents safe list/history/download/upload reservation/archive/cleanup permission matrix and returned role projection.
Real concurrent role/profile/session revocation and workspace-first cross-workflow lock contention; immutable existing nonce receipts/CAS/cancel tombstones unchanged.
Prove no external provider calls or persistent production data; independent review then root-owned production rollback/apply/release.

private_minutes_next_slice.outcome: Current owner/admin opens an existing canonical company workspace, creates a private meeting minute, saves/reopens, edits with CAS, and reads immutable version history.
private_minutes_next_slice.reuse: Existing Company/Operations route and canonical ops_records company ID. Existing ordinary record writer cannot safely represent this private kind because its rows/audit are viewer-readable.
private_minutes_next_slice.storage: Private RLS-revoked current minute + immutable version/audit + actor/account/workspace request receipt/tombstone extension keyed to existing company. No second company/contact/calendar product.
private_minutes_next_slice.recovery: Use the existing Operations opaque-reference recovery pattern; no private minutes body in browser storage. Exact original payload retry only while it remains in memory. After reload, check canonical receipt or atomically cancel-if-missing before a new mutation. Preserve unsent form on ordinary failures; explicitly state that private unsent text is not retained on this device.
private_minutes_next_slice.limits: Internal team-maintained minutes; no approval/e-signature/legal validity/government filing claim. No attachments initially; no Documents permission broadening or duplicate file store. Private registry/roles/legal deadlines remain separate explicit unfinished scope.

separate_documents_gap.finding: Service finalizer checks uploaded_by against raw workspace_members and therefore still refuses actual owner without member after reservation. It locks document/version before checking authority. This is not fixed merely by changing the two helpers or documents_list role projection.
separate_documents_gap.boundary: No attachments in the first minutes slice; do not claim full Documents owner-fallback upload parity. Service finalization/current uploader/session capability and lock-order review requires a separate bounded design and gate.
